services.name: Field Trips & School Tours
services.desc: The San Bernardino County Museum is dedicated to igniting curiosity and a love of learning in students throughout our region. Our programs support educators by enhancing classroom instruction and helping students meet California Common Core and Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS). We welcome school groups, teachers, and students to explore our diverse educational offerings through in-person field trips or virtual learning experiences. Each site features hands-on exhibits in regional history, cultural arts, natural science, and earth science-designed to spark creativity, encourage inquiry, and deepen understanding.
